headline: Kinsale Capital Group Misses Q3 Sales Expectations, Shares Fall
summary: Kinsale Capital Group missed Q3 2026 sales expectations, leading to a drop in its stock price.
why: Kinsale Capital Group is an excess and surplus lines specialty insurance company traded on the NYSE under the ticker KNSL.

impacts.name: Kinsale Capital Group
impacts.why: Falling short of consensus sales estimates directly triggered negative market sentiment and equity selling.

why_moved: A failure to meet top-line revenue expectations prompted investors to reprice the specialty insurer's growth prospects.
